title: Assignment collection
description: subject x facet -> path, with evidence. An assignment without provenance is an opinion, so evidence and provenance are required and confidence has no default. An inference from a module name is not the same fact as a declared tag, and this store must always be able to say which it holds.

confidence.description: 0 to 1. REQUIRED, and never defaulted to 1. A value of 1 asserts the fact was read directly off the artefact, not inferred from it. If you are tempted to write 1 because you have nothing better, the honest value is lower and the evidence block should say why.

evidence.description: At least one. What was observed that supports this assignment.

kind.description: What sort of observation this is. Deliberately not an enum: the set grows as sources do, and closing it here would mean a schema change to record a new kind of evidence.

by.description: agent, human, or the name of a tool.

prompt.description: Ledger entry this assignment came from, so any row can be traced back to the implementation that wrote it.
